never_infer: a model's weights are installed merely because it is listed
selection_policy.promotion_gate: Promote only after fixed task-set evaluation, exact route/checkpoint capture, recurring price and license verification, blind rubric scoring, and a comparable holdout retest.

candidates.access: current ChatGPT session; repository code cannot independently call this session as an API
candidates.note: User-referenced 'ChatGPT 6 Astra' is treated as the current-session baseline label, not as a separately addressable model endpoint. Do not claim API availability or benchmark results without an actual supported route.

candidates.access: exact checkpoint, license, hardware fit, and runtime must be verified
candidates.note: Strong coding-oriented candidate to test first; not a measured winner and not installed by this registry entry.

candidates.access: exact model card, license, quantization, and hardware fit must be verified
candidates.note: Compare against Qwen3-Coder-Next on identical repository tasks; avoid inferring superiority from model name or size.
Choose a specific checkpoint before evaluation. Reasoning traces are not evidence by themselves; score final answers against tests and references.

candidates.access: separate hosted and weight-release terms; verify exact variant and route
candidates.note: Include only if the selected variant can be run within the chosen budget, license, and privacy constraints.

candidates.access: verify exact checkpoint, license, serving requirements, and route
candidates.note: Test structured tool-use and failure recovery rather than relying on vendor claims.

candidates.access: verify exact release license and hardware requirements
candidates.note: Evaluate on issue-to-patch, test repair, and regression detection tasks.

candidates.access: public docs and examples; actual model execution needs authorized access or separately verified route
candidates.note: Public workflows can inspire independent implementations; they do not provide Claude weights or unrestricted free inference.

candidates.access: exact release terms and model card must be reviewed
candidates.note: Do not describe all Gemma releases as OSI-open-source; comply with the exact model terms.

candidates.access: local machine and selected compatible checkpoint
candidates.note: Runtime is not a model. Actual capability depends on checkpoint, quantization, hardware, and configuration.

candidates.access: operator-configured endpoint and explicit upstream route
candidates.note: A gateway is not a model. Unknown, trial, paid, or unstable upstream routes are ineligible for strict zero-cost routing.

evaluation_plan.selection_rule: These are test assignments, not rankings. Choose the winner per role only after blind scoring and comparable retest.
evaluation_plan.promotion_rule: No automatic winner. Keep candidate status UNPROVEN until runs and retests exist.
